method: Fourteen shared catalogs fully decoded with each target exact installed native loader in isolated WindowsCPython3.12; source resource and loader MD5/size verified. Compare with retained exact3640684 native-loader outputs; dogma attributes/effects keyed by ID to avoid order-only differences. English localization uses primitive-only verified pickle reading.

nativeDecodeManifest.method: Exact source native loaders in isolated Windows CPython3.12; all resource bytes verified by MD5 and size

scopeLimits: Dungeon counts are header-only; dungeons were not one of the fourteen native decoded catalog families.
Legacy blueprints.static and industry_*.static are indexed but were not field-decoded; no numerical recipe conversion is inferred.
Landscape/ecosystem/industry_blueprints/Creation-template fsdbinary families are absent where stated by common manifest comparison; their modern data model must not be imposed on these older tables.
Catalog row counts and client metadata are not enabled features or authoritative live server behavior.
Starmap-vs-SQLite planet/station checks and equal cross-build tables do not establish consistency with every other geographical data source or a migrated runtime world.
